title: Mapping POP Attributes to Parameters
summary: Official Derivative page for POP Map pages, covering per-point attribute-driven parameters, Transform POP examples, Combine Operation modes, Sequential Blocks, and pulling mapped attributes from inputs such as _in0.
guidance: Use this article when a POP plan needs parameter values to vary per point from POP attributes rather than remain a single uniform value.
On supported POP parameters, use the Map page to choose an attribute or attribute component and drive that parameter per point.
Use Combine Operation to Add, Multiply, or Set the attribute-driven value relative to the dialog parameter value.
Use Sequential Blocks when multiple attributes should map to multiple parameters in the same POP.
By default, mapped attributes can come from input _in0, with supported POPs exposing menus for valid attributes and target parameters.
